howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.s1: Create a room with your own prizes, or join with a room code. Public rooms can be joined by anyone. A Series plays game after game with the same players.
howToPlay.s2: Before every game choose 1 to 4 tickets. The pot is tickets × ticket price — amounts are just for fun.
howToPlay.s3: Every phone calls the numbers aloud. Tap a called number on your ticket to strike it.
howToPlay.s4: Fast 3/5/7, First/Second/Third Line, Left/Center/Right Column and Full Housie — whatever the host turned on.
howToPlay.s5: The moment your strikes complete a prize it is claimed. If two players complete it on the same number, the amount is split equally.
howToPlay.s6: Every win is saved. In a Series the standings show who won what, game by game.
